description: Find funds (ETFs and mutual funds) that publish holdings to the SEC on Form N-PORT, by name words or ticker, largest first. Each fund has fund_id (SEC series id), tickers, is_etf, its first and newest public portfolio dates. Then use get_fund_holdings for a portfolio, or held_by in get_universe / get_search. Names, tickers and sizes are current, not point in time. Costs 1 credit.

etf_only.description: true: only ETFs listed in TickerDB.

q.description: Words of the fund's name, any order, e.g. "ark innovation" or "core s&p 500".

ticker.description: A fund ticker (e.g. "IVV", "VFIAX") or SEC series id ("S000004310").

name: get_funds

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
